ESO states that the proprietary period protects raw and derived data until release and distributes archive data under CC BY 4.0 with acknowledgment requirements. No product bytes are downloaded.

The anonymous public NED TAP service documents programmatic cone searches of the NED Object Directory and requests NED acknowledgment. CTAS retains bounded source-native rows and provenance only. NOIRLab's provider-owned API authentication notebook states that anyone may retrieve public files while proprietary-file retrieval requires authorization. This adapter sends no credential and retains a product only after an exact file-metadata lookup supplies a nonblank release_date no later than the query time. Anonymous metadata about unreleased files is counted only for exclusion and is never stored. Product bytes are not downloaded.

Rubin alert packets are world-public with no proprietary period, and Fink documents its LSST Science Portal and REST API as real-time, public services requiring no login. Coordinate and first-detection proximity are not proof of source identity.

SIMBAD documents free access without registration under the ODbL license. This adapter uses the anonymous official TAP service for one bounded coordinate query, retains provider attribution and source bibcodes, and does not treat a nearby literature object as the transient, its host, or a new detection.
